technology: PowerShell 5.1 + deterministic rule engines (zero AI calls, zero paid API calls) + versioned JSON contracts (schemaVersion=1)

implementation.taskClassificationV1: PASS - deterministic task-type/complexity/risk/capability/reasoning/context classification; ClassificationSource=DETERMINISTIC; unknown values stay null
implementation.taskTypeVocabulary: PASS - frozen DB-M14 TaskTypes (PLANNING/IMPLEMENTATION/VERIFICATION/REVIEW/RESEARCH/GOVERNANCE); ordered keyword rules, first match wins
implementation.complexityDerivation: PASS - LOW base + additive governed signals (code scope/contract/affected-nodes -> MEDIUM; schema/multi-repo/governance/architecture -> HIGH); small/simple revert rule
implementation.riskPreservation: PASS - governed risk preserved verbatim; derived only when absent (FAIL/BLOCKED verdict or blocker -> HIGH; conflict WARN -> MEDIUM); no signal -> UNKNOWN
implementation.capabilityRequirement: PASS - requires coding/reasoning/vision/tool-use/structured-output/human-review derived by fixed rules; null when no signal
implementation.minimumReasoningLevel: PASS - DB-M13 rule encoded (HIGH risk/complexity/schema -> at least HIGH, ReasoningRuleApplied=true); MEDIUM defaults not rule-applied
implementation.contextRequirement: PASS - weighted signal score (>=5 VERY_HIGH, >=3 HIGH, >=2 MEDIUM, else LOW); governed fixture lands HIGH (score 4)
implementation.tokenPlanning: PASS - RequiredContextTokens + ExpectedOutputTokens approximate, labeled, one method (chars/4)
implementation.capabilityRequirementContractReuse: PASS - New-CapabilityRequirement derives DB-M14 v1 AiCapabilityRequirement (SchemaVersion 1); AllowedProviders/AllowedModels empty, ExecutionMode MANUAL, MaxAllowedCost null
implementation.contextBudgetV1: PASS - plan per section; FITS/REDUCED/EXCEEDS; INCLUDE/EXCERPT/EXCLUDE; mandatory never excluded; EXCEEDS produces explicit FAILED package
implementation.contextPackageV1: PASS - 7 mandatory sections never dropped; deterministic reduction; secret guard + redaction; stable SHA-256 PackageHash; provenance recorded
implementation.smallestAuthoritativePackage: PASS - never sends entire repo/workbook/history; low-value dropped first, then optional; large mandatory files excerpted deterministically with explicit marker
implementation.secretProtection: PASS - DB-M17/DB-M14 secret guards reused; suspicious content excluded + SecretWarnings; raw secret never reaches package
implementation.manualWorkflowPreserved: YES - ExecutionMode defaults MANUAL; package is a handoff artifact (CHATGPT/DeepSeek/Claude), does not replace DB-M05/DB-M07
implementation.schemaFreeze: PASS - TaskClassificationVersion=1, ContextBudgetVersion=1, ContextPackageVersion=1 frozen; CapabilityRequirement stays DB-M14 v1; incompatible change requires v2
